prompt:
I'm a HubSpot implementation consultant trying to grow my visibility and win inbound leads through the HubSpot Community. I've heard that some consultants have built serious reputations there, but I don't know where to start.

I need a single, comprehensive playbook document saved as `community_playbook.md` that covers everything I need for this week:

1. A teardown of one of the top recognized contributors on the platform — specifically DarrenScottUK — so I understand exactly what makes their participation effective and what I should replicate.

2. A scan of the best answer opportunities available right now, based on the raw thread data I've collected in my workspace. I want to know which specific threads I should prioritize and why.

3. Draft at least one high-quality reply for one of the top-priority threads — a real, useful reply I could actually send (after review), not a template.

4. A scorecard I can use to track my own progress week over week.

I've collected research files, competitor profile data, and thread snapshots in the workspace already. Use those as your source material.
